findings.F1: Inside the falling calm profile, the scaled 5-day push shows the tested idea's direction but not reliably. On the 5-day grid, its slope on the coin's 5-day forward return minus drift is +1.9 % per standard deviation, with a day-clustered t of 1.53 over 121 samples. Quintile means run from -5.4 % (q1) to +1.4 % (q4), then +0.6 % (q5). The same slope outside the profile is +0.2 % (t 0.19, 572 samples).
findings.F2: The proposal with the largest t is the share of up days over the last 20 days. It has a slope of +1.5 % per standard deviation in profile (t 1.91, 129 samples), but it does not hold together:
findings.F3: None of the other eight in-profile features reaches a t of 1. These are the 1-day scaled return, the 20-day scaled return, the close location, the scaled range, the scaled body, the volume ratio, the 60-day drawdown and the volatility change; their t runs from -0.25 to 0.86 over 117 to 146 samples.
findings.F4: The book's gain sits on a few days. Its 593 active coin-days sum to +0.87, of which the ten best days give +0.73 and the ten worst take -0.55.
findings.F6: Trades entered on the lowest-forecast half earned more than those on the highest half: +5.7 % in each of the two lowest quartiles (59 trades each) against +1.3 % and +2.5 % in the two highest (58 and 59). This runs against the idea's grading, but with standard deviations of 7 to 17 % it cannot be told from chance.
findings.F7: The in-profile 5-day return minus drift averages -0.8 % (t -1.00, 146 samples). Across weekdays it runs from -5.0 % (Thursday, t -1.76, 14 samples) to +4.1 % (Tuesday, t 1.58, 17 samples). With seven groups that small, none stands out.

no_ideas: Across 20 feature slopes in and out of the falling calm profile, quintiles, weekdays, coins, years, trades and the book's largest days, no pattern reaches a t of 2 that holds across coins and years. The strongest candidates are the scaled push itself (t 1.53) and the share of up days (t 1.91, sign flipping by coin and year), and with this many angles both are within chance.
